component: QB assignment upstream of depth PMF
top_five.cost_access: Sportradar/SportsDataIO keys and quoted contract; timestamped news archive separate. ESPN-derived depth reuse unresolved.
top_five.football_mechanism: A receiver catches throws from the actual expected thrower. Starter change, injury limitation and uncertainty alter depth intent/throw windows rather than uniformly scaling final yards.
top_five.historical_validation: NOT CLEARED: need original pregame depth/practice/announcement versions for2024 fit/selection and subsequent frozen validation. 2025 dt only supplies loaded expected hierarchy, not verified announcement/restrictions.
top_five.information: Timestamped QB starter/replacement AND health/practice state
top_five.live_deployment: Feasible from licensed state/news feeds with published_at + observed_at + SHA snapshots. Keep verified/expected/uncertain/multi-QB/emergency distinctions; no fake starter probability.
top_five.phase1i_failure_addressed: Prior current-team passing-volume assignment is not a verified starter; receiver/QB pair estimates can be attached to the wrong or constrained QB.
top_five.recommendation: ACQUIRE feasibility sample/archive terms first; BUILD state/receipt layer only after rights and as-of acceptance. No model protocol or deployment in Phase1J.

top_five.cost_access: FTN commercial starts$5,000/year per FAQ, field package/terms to confirm; SIS/TruMedia quotes/eligibility unknown.
top_five.football_mechanism: A route-running receiver differs from a blocker; slot/outside/inline and route intent change likely target depth and contest. Two identical target averages can conceal very different deployment.
top_five.historical_validation: FTN documents2019+ charting/participation and2021+ expanded participation. Sample all-player roles/positions, completeness, stable IDs and original versions needed; no current access.
top_five.information: Actual all-player route participation plus alignment/route intent
top_five.live_deployment: Licensed postgame charting history can feed the next pregame cutoff after actual receipt. Target-game route/alignment values forbidden; true live means current prior-game availability, not future route oracle.
top_five.phase1i_failure_addressed: Marginal receiver depth signal exists but the hierarchy lacks changing route/deployment intent. PBP on-field participation cannot supply routes-run.
top_five.recommendation: ACQUIRE FTN sample and immutable-vintage offer before alternatives; require real per-player route role (RTE/FRTE/BRTE vsPPRO), no offense_players proxy. Do not fit until accepted.

top_five.cost_access: Public FTN subset free with attribution/share-alike; full FTN commercial quote starts$5,000/year. NGS intended-use rights and archive required.
top_five.football_mechanism: A deep incompletion can be an inaccurate throw, closed window, drop or defended ball. Raw labels distinguish those mechanisms rather than treating all completion rates as receiver talent.
top_five.historical_validation: Public catchable/contested/drop joins cover all2023-25 targets, but retained retrieval times are backfilled; 2024 fit-vintage and2025 replay NOT certified. Full FTN categorical separation needs definitions/sample.
top_five.information: Depth-specific throw catchability, separation and contested/drop labels
top_five.live_deployment: Public subset can be archived lawfully under CC-BY-SA with observed cutoff receipts; richer licensed API is viable. NGS target-selected aggregate is not route-level separation and has min-attempt gaps.
top_five.phase1i_failure_addressed: Observed completion-by-depth did not establish an efficiency replacement; completed-air production remains limited by target quality that PBP does not identify.
top_five.recommendation: BUILD source-only forward receipts in a separate authorized protocol; ACQUIRE original historical versions. Catchable excludes defended-away balls: do not label it pure QB accuracy or combine without mechanism tests.

top_five.cost_access: State-feed license plus FTN/SIS/TruMedia detailed charting; price and archive rights contract-specific.
top_five.football_mechanism: Likely assigned corner/safety help and injured replacements affect contest/leverage on specific depth/routes, beyond an undifferentiated opponent yards-allowed mean.
top_five.historical_validation: BLOCKED current access: original injury/practice revisions, prior-game defender associations and field-level current-season coverage timestamps required. Do not retrospectively infer missing DBs from snaps.
top_five.information: Current defensive personnel plus receiver/defender association and coverage state
top_five.live_deployment: Licensed injury receipts and prior-game charting can be combined after acceptance. Associated defender is not verified future shadow coverage; expose probabilistic/uncertain assignment only under new protocol.
top_five.phase1i_failure_addressed: Coarse opponent depth allowance failed to supply direct matchup information; current2026 man/zone/true pressure is missing and prior season is stale.
top_five.recommendation: ACQUIRE only if prior original versions and association definitions are demonstrable; do not build a defender-absence oracle or reuse stale man/zone as current.

top_five.cost_access: PublicFTN free withCC-BY-SA attribution; richer licensed FTN commercial starts$5,000/year.
top_five.football_mechanism: First reads and designed releases show offensive intent and route timing. Reactive checkdowns and scramble drills have a different depth/catchability context from planned involvement.
top_five.historical_validation: Public read_thrown0/1/2,CHK,DES,SD and motion labels exist2023+, but retained historical date_pulled cannot certify2024/25 cutoffs. Firstread thrown is not firstread target share over all routes.
top_five.live_deployment: Can archive eligible prior-game labels after actual receipt; motion boolean is not proof motion created a target. Full API fread/route/read details need semantics/sample.
top_five.phase1i_failure_addressed: Target depth is treated as an empirical distribution without which receiver the play was built for; pair history alone misses role intent after personnel/QB changes.
top_five.recommendation: ACQUIRE rawread/route semantics and versions, then BUILD audited counts only; keep designed, firstread, checkdown, scramble and motion distinct. No performance test inJ.
